title: Model the acceptance-wake stall in the coordination TLA+ model: an owner must not sleep after credit settles without a host or coordinator wake
outcome: Model the acceptance-wake stall in the coordination TLA+ model: an owner must not sleep after credit settles without a host or coordinator wake
acceptance: The coordination TLA+ model under target/ adds the states and transitions awaitEvalRequest, CreditSettles, RequestEvaluation and SleepWithoutReady, plus only the steps that carry the wake into RequestEvaluation: a host event delivery, or a named coordinator READY message and the coordinator's wake of the owner, with the message state they need. Coord.tla and the rest of the model are otherwise unchanged.
A matching negative control shows the model catches an owner that sleeps after credit settles with no wake
One bounded run of one round passes; no production change, no long rerun and no unrelated v9 changes; Kimi reviews the C6 delta afterwards

completion.summary:
Acceptance-after-credit seam added to the coordination TLA+ model, as one bounded one-round check.
DELIVERED, frozen package Central target\tla-coord\handoff-acc (18 files):
- spec/Coord.tla (v9, byte-identical to handoff-v9e) and spec/CoordAcc.tla. CoordAcc EXTENDS Coord with the phase awaitEvalRequest and the steps CreditSettles, RequestEvaluation (reuses the settled evidence: wExec unchanged) and SleepWithoutReady (negative control). The wake into the request is either the host event (HEVAL) or a named coordinator path: READY to D, then D's EVALWAKE. AccNoUnnamedWait and AccStallIsExplicit reuse Coord's properties with the new wait.
- 5 configurations, the DL560 job, 8 TLC outputs and a bare-facts README.
RESULTS (DL560, 2026-11-22 18:29:54-18:31:24Z, one round):
- AccReady and AccHost: no error over complete state spaces (49,027 and 19,849 distinct states).
- NegSleepWithoutReady: AccNoUnnamedWait violated, an 11-state trace reproducing the B3C1 'next turn' sleep.
- WitAccReady and WitAccHost: both positive paths reached.
REVIEW: Kimi's C6 delta review passed (quoted in holder note f2ca5566). C1 was revised verbatim per Fable's ruling 50c37875 (a wording defect). The independent re-evaluation (Codex session-19568, superseding 61650e63) passed 3/3.
CLEANUP, released for Codex on the DL560 lane: target/tla-5804-acc/ and target/jobs/s4-tlc-5804/. On Central, handoff-acc stays as the record; the scratch files mkjob9acc.py, unpack9acc.py, steps.py, the stage/request .msg files and results-r9acc can go in the same target\tla-coord sweep already listed for w-869f.
